recommendation: Keep this audit commit and do not re-add the id parameter for FHIR-13987. A future type-level or remote-Composition document-generation design should be handled by a new SD issue because it would reverse the later FHIR-19974 cleanup.
issue_request: FHIR-13987 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for STU3 Composition. It reported that Composition/$document was incorrectly declared for both instance and type use because [base]/Composition/$document did not identify which Composition to use; the resolution added an id input parameter, and comments treated the GraphDefinition parameter portion as a duplicate of FHIR-13856.
initial_application: The issue was applied historically. Jira records svn revision 13105, and git-svn commit 9b504f3a74145babd8481e5c5b6a79cbb66918d7 records GF#13987 adding Composition/$document.id. The current XML source lineage also shows the old applied shape before FHIR-19974: type=true, instance=true, and a type-scoped id input parameter typed uri.
additional_context: The GraphDefinition request is already handled by FHIR-13856 and FHIR-14391, both represented on the combined branch, and the active operation still has the graph parameter. Later FHIR-19974 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for the same operation; SD minutes on 2023-02-09 approved removing [base]/Composition/$document and the id parameter because $document always requires an existing Composition. Commit 7f9f6257cc05849685341f1e521e5fe616032d56 applied that later decision.
reconciliation: Made no source change. source/fhir.ini keeps Composition active, source/composition/list-Composition-operations.xml references OperationDefinition/Composition-document, and source/composition/operationdefinition-Composition-document.xml now has system=false, type=false, instance=true, graph present, and no id input.
